header: Metered resources against the Business plan cap

stats_dashboard_metrics.title: Events
stats_dashboard_metrics.subtext: Around 5.8 million events left with nine days of the billing period to run, which matches last month's pace.

stats_dashboard_metrics.title: Query calls

stats_dashboard_metrics.title: Raw export storage
stats_dashboard_metrics.subtext: At the current rate exports reach the cap in eleven days; anything older than 90 days is deleted for you.
